data.name: Michaia
data.gender_notes: Michaia is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Michaia is recorded in name-lists as “Who is like God?”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Michaia expresses “Who is like God?”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Michaia total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: מִיכָאִיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מִיכָאִיה הוּא שֵׁם עִבְרִי שֶׁמֶשִׁים אֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאֱלֹהִים, בְּתוֹרָה וּבַנְבִיאִים, הַשֵּׁם הַזֶּה הוּא קִיצוּר שֶׁל מִיכָאֵל, שֶׁפִּרוּשׁוֹ הוּא 'מִי כָּמוֹךָ אֱלֹהִים'

in_greek.name: Μιχαία
in_greek.meaning: Ο Μιχαίας είναι όνομα που σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι ο Βασιλιάς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μιχαία είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος Μιχαία, που σημαίνει ο Θεός είναι ο Βασιλιάς, και είναι συνδεδεμένο με τον Michaiah της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης, einen προφήτη που έζησε στον 8ο αιώνα π.Χ.

in_latin.name: Michaia
in_latin.meaning: Deus est Rex, qui est Michaele
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Michaia est forma latina nominis hebraici Michaia, quod significat Deus est Rex, et est coniunctum cum Michaele, qui est nomen archangeli in traditione christiana, et qui significat quis ut Deus
